subject.title: PR Limit Update: Why We Now Cap at 20 Open PRs Per Author

question: Should this pinned PR-limit announcement remain open as the live repository policy notice now that CONTRIBUTING.md, the labeler workflow, and Barnacle document the 20-PR cap?
rationale: A human maintainer reopened and pinned the issue after the related docs change merged, so the remaining question is repository-governance intent rather than source-level implementation.

options.title: Keep pinned notice open
options.body: Leave this issue open as the living announcement for the current 20-PR cap and rely on docs plus automation for enforcement.

options.title: Close as documented policy
options.body: Close it only if maintainers no longer want an open pinned governance notice and CONTRIBUTING.md is enough.

recommendation.title: Keep pinned notice open
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the living announcement for the current 20-PR cap and rely on docs plus automation for enforcement.
